name: FLIR Lepton 3.5 Thermal Camera Module
notes: Primary recommended thermal core. Export-controlled; international orders require an End Use Statement. Wide-angle alternative: optional FLIR Lepton 3.1R (95 deg HFOV, 500-0758-03).

name: FLIR Lepton 3.1R Wide-Angle Thermal Module
value_spec: 160x120 LWIR, Radiometric, 95 deg HFOV (119 deg DFOV), Shutter
notes: Optional 95 deg wide-angle alternative to Lepton 3.5 (excluded from required total). Both V3.0 and V4.0 parametric enclosures clear its full 119 deg DFOV cone with zero vignetting.

name: FLIR Lepton 2.5 Thermal Camera Module
notes: Optional budget alternative to Lepton 3.5 (excluded from required total). FLIR EOL notice (last buy Sept 2027); prefer Lepton 3.5 or 3.1R.

name: FLIR Lepton Breakout Board V2.0
notes: Required carrier for Lepton 3.5/3.1R/2.5. Do not substitute PureThermal USB UVC boards (they lack the 2x10 SPI header).

name: Teensy 4.1 Development Board
value_spec: ARM Cortex-M7 600MHz, 8MB Flash, microSD (pre-pinned for V4.0)
notes: Also stocked at Adafruit (ID 4622). V3.0 uses unpinned Teensy + VUSB-VIN pad cut. V4.0 uses pre-pinned Teensy 4.1 (TEENSY41-PINS) plus a 1x5 inner header for J7 (VBAT/PROG); no VUSB cut needed when using board-edge USB-C.

name: 3.2 Inch 240x320 TFT LCD Touch Display
value_spec: ILI9341 4-Wire SPI, 5V Supply, XPT2046 Resistive Touch
notes: Select exact options: Pin Header 4-Wire SPI, 5V Power Supply, 3.2-inch Resistive Touch Panel, No Font Chip. 2x20 2.54mm header pinout.

name: 32GB Class 10 / U1 microSDHC Card
notes: Any 16GB-32GB Class 10 / U1 microSDHC formatted FAT32 or exFAT works reliably with Teensy 4.1 SDIO.

name: DIY-Thermocam 2-Layer PCB
notes: Estimated per-board cost in qty 5 (excl. shipping/PCBA). Upload KiCad fab package (hardware/pcb/kicad-v4.0/fab/ or kicad-v3.0/fab/) to JLCPCB, Seeed Fusion, or PCBWay.

name: DIY-Thermocam Enclosure
value_spec: 3D-Printed PETG/PA12 Shell (recommended V4.0) OR 3mm Laser Acrylic
notes: Generated parametrically from hardware/enclosure/ (STEP, STL, 3MF, laser SVG/DXF). 3D shell includes flush dovetail lens cap, wide-angle 119 deg DFOV cone, and V4.0 battery cradle/actuators.

name: M2.5 Enclosure Standoff & Screw Kit
value_spec: 4x M2.5x5 M-F, 4x M2.5x11 M-F, 4x M2.5x20 F-F, 4x M2.5x6 + 4x M2.5x8 DIN 965 CSK, 4x 1.8mm Nylon Washers
notes: Full assortment pack ($16.95); individual ISO/DIN hardware costs ~$4 locally. Use 4x M2.5x6 front + 4x M2.5x8 back DIN 965 / ISO 10642 countersunk screws for flush 3D shell seating.

name: M2 Lepton & Display Fastener Set
value_spec: 4x M2x18 DIN 84, 4x M2x12 Spacer, 4x M2 Nylon Nut DIN 934, 3x M2x8 DIN 965, 3x M2 Nut+Washer
notes: Standard ISO/DIN M2 metric hardware available from any hardware supplier; estimated unit-build cost $4.00.

name: 1/4-20 UNC Tripod Mount Nut / Insert
value_spec: 1/4-20 UNC Standard Metal Hex Nut (V4.0/V3.0 3D Shell) OR Tee Nut (Acrylic)
notes: Parametric 3D back shell uses a captive metal 1/4-20 hex nut behind a 3.0mm blind roof (no soldering iron; max tripod stud <= 8.0mm). Laser acrylic uses a 1/4-20 tee nut.

name: Pololu 5V Step-Up Voltage Regulator U3V16F5
notes: V3.0 external 5V boost module (V4.0 integrates TI TPS61022RWUR onboard). Stocked in EU via Botland/BerryBase.

name: Protected 3.7V 2000mAh Li-Ion/LiPo Pouch Battery (V3.0)
notes: V3.0 replacement for obsolete Samsung EB-BG355BBE. Standard protected 2000mAh cell (60x36x7mm or 103450 50x34x10mm). Always verify JST-PH polarity before connecting.

name: Miniature Power Switch (V3.0)
notes: V3.0 panel switch (V4.0 integrates SW1 JS102011SAQN onboard). Solder wires horizontally to keep clearance inside enclosure (issue #101).

name: Panel-Mount Momentary Pushbutton (V3.0)
notes: V3.0 panel capture button (V4.0 integrates SW2 B3U-3000P onboard). E-Switch PV5S640SS (12mm IP65) is an active industrial backup.

name: CR1220 3V Lithium Coin Cell (V3.0)
notes: V3.0 RTC backup coin cell (V4.0 replaces coin cell with 1uA XC6206P332MR-G LDO fed from main LiPo).

name: 2x20 (40-Pin) Female Header Socket (V3.0)
notes: Mates with BuyDisplay ER-TFTM032-3 on V3.0. Any standard 2x20 2.54mm female socket fits.

name: 2x10 (20-Pin) Female Header Socket (V3.0)
notes: Mates with FLIR Lepton Breakout Board V2.0 on V3.0.

name: 2.54mm Break-Away Male Pin Header Strip Pack (V3.0)
notes: V3.0 pack price ($4.95 for 360 pins). Used for Teensy 4.1, Booster, and jumper pins.

name: 2.54mm Female Header Strip Pack (V3.0)
notes: V3.0 pack price ($2.95 for 180 pins). Sockets Teensy 4.1 cleanly onto V3.0 PCB.

name: 26 AWG Silicone Stranded Hook-Up Wire Red (V3.0)
notes: V3.0 pack price (2m). Short lengths for power switch, capture button, and TP4056 charger wiring.

name: 26 AWG Silicone Stranded Hook-Up Wire Black (V3.0)
notes: V3.0 pack price (2m). Ground/return wiring for switch and capture button.

name: Heat Shrink Tubing Assortment (V3.0)
notes: V3.0 only. Keep sleeves short at button terminals to avoid mechanical strain against the display (issue #101).

name: TP4056 1A Li-Ion Charger Module w/ Protection
notes: V3.0 workaround for obsolete TP4057 (issue #103). Wire IN+/IN- to JP4/JP1 and OUT+/OUT- to LIPO/SWITCH; no power-path. Branded alt: Adafruit Micro-Lipo USB-C (ID 4410, $5.95, 500mA).

name: Bi-Color Charging Status LED (3mm/5mm THT)
notes: V3.0 external status LED wired to CHG-LED/LASER1 pads; leave 1-2mm lead standoff before bending 90 deg to align with enclosure hole (issues #93, #101).

name: CR1220 Coin Cell Holder (Through-Hole)
notes: Matches V3.0 Eagle/KiCad footprint BATTCON_12MM_PTH.

name: 4.7k Ohm 1% 1/4W Axial Resistor
notes: V3.0 I2C pull-ups (R4, R6) and battery/VUSB voltage dividers (R1, R3).

name: 10k Ohm 1% 1/4W Axial Resistor
notes: V3.0 lower legs of battery (R2 -> D23) and VUSB (R5 -> A16) voltage dividers.

name: USB-A to Micro-B Data/Power Cable
notes: Must support USB data (not charge-only) for V3.0 firmware flashing and USB v2 streaming.

name: Slim Protected 3.7V 2000mAh 505060 LiPo Battery (V4.0)
notes: V4.0 3D enclosure battery cradle requires <=5.0mm nominal thickness (5.5mm max swell) UL/IEC 62133 protected 505060 pouch with standard Adafruit/SparkFun JST-PH polarity (verify +/- against J4 silkscreen). Slim 5.0mm 1200mAh drop-in alt: Adafruit ID 258.

name: USB-A to USB-C Data/Power Cable (V4.0)
notes: Single USB-C cable handles charging, USB Protocol v2 streaming, and Teensy firmware updates on V4.0.

name: TI BQ24074 Li-Ion Power-Path Charger IC
value_spec: 1.5A Dynamic Power-Path Charger, 4.4V VSYS, ITERM Pin
notes: V4.0 PCBA charger regulating VSYS to 4.4V (< TPS61022 4.8V cold-start max). R11=1.2k (1.3A ILIM), R10=1.0k (890mA ISET), R23=3.0k (90mA ITERM), R14=47k (~6.3h timer).

name: TI TPS61022 Synchronous 5V Boost Converter
value_spec: 8A Switch, 5.10V Out (R16=750k / R17=100k), True Load Disconnect
notes: Replaces Pololu U3V16F5 on V4.0. Driven by SW1 on EN pin so battery charges cleanly while camera is switched OFF.

name: XC6206P332MR-G 3.3V Low-Quiescent RTC LDO
notes: Replaces CR1220 coin cell and holder on V4.0. Powers Teensy 4.1 VBAT (VDD_SNVS_IN 2.4-3.6V) from protected VLIPO at ~1uA. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.0uH 15A Shielded Power Inductor
notes: High-current power inductor paired with TPS61022RWUR (U2) on 1.0mm BOOST_SW copper pour.

name: 2A Resettable PTC Polyfuse (1206)
notes: Series battery overcurrent protection following Q1/Q2 reverse-polarity MOSFET interlock.

name: USB 2.0 ESD Protection Diode Array
notes: Protects Teensy USB D+/D- differential pair at board-edge USB-C receptacle J3.

name: Red 0603 SMD Charging Status LED
notes: Driven by BQ24074 open-drain ~CHG pin (lit while charging). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: AO3401A P-Channel MOSFET (Reverse-Polarity)
notes: Primary active reverse-polarity LiPo protection MOSFET on J4. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: AO3400A N-Channel MOSFET (Gate Interlock)
notes: Gate interlock keeping Q1 hard-OFF into a reversed LiPo even when USB-C is plugged in (<10uA quiescent). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: USB Type-C 16-Pin SMD Receptacle
notes: Board-edge USB-C port feeding BQ24074 IN and Teensy 4.1 D+/D- pogo pins P1/P2.

name: JST-PH 2.0mm 2-Pin SMD Battery Header
notes: Standard Adafruit/SparkFun LiPo polarity (always verify +/- silkscreen before connecting). Protected by Q1/Q2 + F1.

name: 2x20 (40-Pin) Female Display Socket (V4.0 PCBA)
notes: Top-side (F.Cu) socket mating with BuyDisplay ER-TFTM032-3. Order THT PCBA or hand-solder if using single-sided B.Cu assembly.

name: 2x10 (20-Pin) Female Lepton Socket (V4.0 PCBA)
notes: Factory-populated B.Cu socket mating with FLIR Lepton Breakout Board V2.0.

name: 1x24 (24-Pin) Female Teensy Socket (V4.0 PCBA)
notes: Factory-populated B.Cu outer sockets for pre-pinned Teensy 4.1 (8.5mm height matches P1/P2 pogo working height).

name: 1x5 (5-Pin) Female Inner Teensy Socket (V4.0 PCBA)
notes: Mates with Teensy 4.1 inner 5-pin pads (VBAT/PROG). Solder a 1x5 header to pre-pinned Teensy 4.1 if not factory-installed.

name: SMD Spring Pogo Pin (12.0mm Free / 11.0mm Working)
value_spec: 2.0mm Base, 12.0mm Free Height, USB D+/D- Tap
notes: Zero-solder spring contacts engaging Teensy 4.1 underside USB D+ (P1) and D- (P2) pads (0.00mm length skew). Verify alignment on first physical prototype.

name: Right-Angle SMD Slide Power Switch
notes: Board-edge power switch driving TPS61022 EN pin (battery continues charging when OFF). Actuated by V4.0 slide_switch_cap.

name: Right-Angle SMD Tactile Capture Switch
notes: Board-edge shutter capture button on D2. Actuated by V4.0 capture_button plunger with housing hard-stop.

name: SMD Tactile Pinhole PROG Switch
notes: Accessible through rear enclosure pinhole to enter Teensy HalfKay bootloader. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 10uF 25V X5R 0805 MLCC Capacitor
notes: BQ24074 IN/OUT/BAT and rail decoupling capacitors. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 100nF 50V X7R 0603 MLCC Capacitor
notes: High-frequency bypass decoupling for power, ESD, and RTC LDO rails. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 22uF 10V X5R 0805 MLCC Capacitor
notes: TPS61022 input/output bulk capacitors placed tight to U2 pins on B.Cu. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 47k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Battery ADC upper divider (R1, 10/14.7 ratio), BQ24074 TMR ~6.3h safety timer (R14), and reverse-polarity bias (R20). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.0k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 R_ISET (R10, ~890mA charge current) and ~CHG LED current limiter (R12). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.2k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 R_ILIM (1.3A USB input current limit, >= TI 1.1k minimum). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 100k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Low-drain battery/VBUS ADC dividers (R2,R3,R5), TPS61022 EN pull-down (R15), and FB lower leg (R17). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 750k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: TPS61022 5.10V FB upper leg (R16) and ultra-low-drain Q1/Q2 gate interlock pull resistors (R18, R21).

name: 10k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 TS pull-down (R9), LCD backlight pull-up (R19), and BQ24074 EN2 pull-up to regulated VSYS (R22). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 3.0k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 ITERM termination programming resistor (~90mA / 10.1% charge termination). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 4.7k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: I2C SDA0/SCL0 pull-up resistors for FLIR Lepton CCI (R4, R6). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 5.1k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Mandatory USB-C CC1 and CC2 sink pull-downs to request 5V from USB-C PD chargers. JLCPCB Basic part.
